PHPUnit only executes test methods in classes that extend PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase (or use attributes like #[Test] on non-TestCase classes, but standard test discovery requires inheritance or specific configuration).

Data providers allow running the same test multiple times with different sets of arguments, not just one.

PHPUnit does not support declaring dependencies between tests; each test must be independent.
